application_credentials.description: Follow the [Google Photos Picker setup instructions]({more_info_url}) to create an OAuth client ID. Use redirect URI: `{redirect_url}`. After creating credentials at {oauth_creds_url}, enter the Client ID and Client Secret below.

pick_media.title: Pick photos
pick_media.description:
1. Open the [Google Photos Picker]({picker_uri}) in your browser **while signed in to the same Google account**.
2. Select the photos or album you want to rotate.
3. Confirm your selection in Google Photos.
4. Come back here and press **Submit**.

If you press Submit before confirming in Google Photos, you'll be asked to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Google Photos
reauth_confirm.description: Your Google Photos access has expired or been revoked (Google revokes tokens for apps in Testing mode roughly every 7 days). Press **Submit** to sign in again. Your existing photo selection is preserved.

error.picker_not_ready: Selection not detected yet. Confirm your photo selection in Google Photos, then press Submit again.
error.picker_session_failed: Could not communicate with Google Photos Picker. Check your network and try again.

abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url}).
abort.picker_session_failed: Failed to create a Google Photos Picker session.
abort.list_items_failed: Failed to list picked media items.
abort.no_items_picked: No items were picked in the Google Photos Picker.
abort.token_refresh_failed: Could not refresh OAuth token. Remove and re-add the integration.
abort.wrong_account: Re-authentication must use the same Google account.

init.title: Google Photos Rotator options
init.description: Optional face detection. Runs in a separate **GPhotos Face Detector** add-on / container (the integration just calls an HTTP API), because no in-process face detection library has wheels for HA OS / Python 3.14 yet. Install the add-on from this integration's repository, or run the standalone container at `ghcr.io/moimart/gphotos-face-detector`. Coordinates are exposed via the **Faces count** sensor's `faces` attribute (normalized 0–1) for pan-and-zoom dashboard cards.

data.face_min_area_fraction: Minimum face area as fraction of image (kills background heads — 0 = keep all)
data.face_max_count: Max faces to keep (sorted by area; 0 = unlimited; 1 = main subject only)

next.name: Next photo
next.description: Immediately rotate to the next photo.

repick.name: Re-pick photos
repick.description: Start a new Google Photos picker session to select a fresh set of photos.

entity_id.name: Image entity
entity_id.description: The image entity belonging to the instance you want to re-pick for.
